## Setup

## Load Data

```{r}
nhanes <- read_csv("examples/nhanes-equity/data/nhanes_equity_v6.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## Inspect

```{r}
dim(nhanes)
names(nhanes)

colSums(is.na(nhanes))
```

## Summarize

Replace this example with your own summary if you choose a different question.

```{r}
bmi_by_edu <- nhanes |>
  filter(!is.na(BMI), !is.na(EducationClean)) |>
  group_by(EducationClean) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_bmi = mean(BMI),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

bmi_by_edu
```

## Function

```{r}
mean_sd <- function(x) {
  tibble(
    mean = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

mean_sd(nhanes$BMI)

#AI prompt: make another function that counts the n in categorical variables
count_categories <- function(x) {
  tibble(category = x) |>
    count(category, name = "n")
}

count_categories(nhanes$EducationClean)
```
